verdict.rationale: Loops has dynamic segments (loops-docs-16, loops-docs-31), but they are only described as a dashboard feature. The API scope covers contacts, events, transactional email, campaigns, content, themes and workflows. The MCP server covers contacts, mailing lists, events and content. Neither lists segment creation or contact filtering, so nothing shows an agent turning an audience description into a real segment. Manually managed mailing lists are not dynamic segments and do not count as delivering this story.
